text:
eli_support: FYI new Brightvale tenant created via SSO but no service credential ended up on the project. Customer hitting 403 on /v1/generate. Blocking onboarding.
provisioner-bot: Provisioner job job-8732 started for tenant brightvale (org: brightvale-org). Status: SUCCESS - token created. trace_id=trc-8732
eli_support: I tried a quick repro: console shows token present but API request returns 403. GET /v1/keys -> [] (no keys returned). Error payload: {
  "code":403,
  "message":"missing_service_role: service account binding skipped"
}
jordan: Can you paste the provisioner logs (tail around job-8732) and the org id?
eli_support: org id brightvale-org. Logs: ```
2026-04-05T14:02:31Z provisioner INFO job-8732: created token record id tok-29
2026-04-05T14:02:34Z provisioner WARN job-8732: failed to bind service role: IAM policy prevents role/grant on target org
2026-04-05T14:02:34Z provisioner INFO job-8732: marking token as created but unbound
```
maria: That WARN is the issue — customer org has an org-policy / IAM constraint preventing the provisioner service account from granting the required role. The provisioner still writes a token record but the service account that actually needs to be bound never gets the role. Need either a manual service-account creation + role bind or customer allows the role grant.
sam: Escalating to platform-provisioning. @jordan please follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/provisioner-iam-block (manual reconcile section). Also capture the customer consent email thread before making changes.
eli_support: Customer gave consent for a manual fix, wants it done ASAP (they're in P1 onboarding).
jordan: Manual reconciliation steps I'm going to run: ```
# create SA in customer's project (requires org-owner or delegated role)
gcloud iam service-accounts create redwood-provisioner-sa --project=brightvale-p
# bind roles
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding brightvale-p --member=serviceAccount:redwood-provisioner-sa@brightvale-p.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
# re-run provisioner for trace trc-8732
```
jordan: kicking off reconcile job job-8732-reconcile now (trace trc-8732). I'll post updates. ETA ~25m.
provisioner-bot: Reconcile job job-8732-reconcile queued. status=PENDING
jordan: Reconcile finished: provisioner success, token id tok-29 now bound to service account redwood-provisioner-sa. Verified console shows key and GET /v1/keys returns 1 entry.
eli_support: Customer confirms API calls now succeed and onboarding continues. Thanks all.
maria: Filing a post-onboard follow-up to see if we can detect org-policy constraints earlier in the flow and fail fast.
sam: Noted for the onboarding checklist and CS playbook. Closing on our side once customer confirms billing link.
